slot_scores.name: ending_backorders_zero
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional requirements or restrictions on the plan that are not yet stated, such as a maximum or minimum workforce size, a limit on total backorders, or a requirement that all demand eventually be fulfilled?
slot_scores.rationale: Although framed as a catch-all, the question explicitly targets the terminal condition on backorders by asking whether there is a requirement that all demand eventually be fulfilled, which is semantically equivalent to the reference question about clearing all backorders by end of June.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only listed hidden slot (H1, P1) was resolved at turn 7 when the user confirmed all backorders must be cleared by end of June; afterward the agent looped on the same low-value revenue-recognition question for roughly twenty consecutive turns instead of moving to the model, never reaching READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the single hidden slot (end-of-horizon backorder clearing) through a broad but explicitly targeted catch-all question early on, but then burned the rest of the interview repeating one unconfirmable revenue-recognition question verbatim, never converging to a modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
